author: Brian Trepanier (CMBC)
changes: Decimated from 536k to 59k triangles, re-oriented and rescaled; given a skeleton (24 bones, its ears and jaw included) skinned by bone heat on a voxel-remeshed copy and copied across (tools/characters/boss_build.py); the full sculpt's detail baked into a tangent-space normal map (2048) and its ambient occlusion darkened into the colour map, upscaled to 2048; its roughness set for skin (the download's left it a mirror's); its amber eyes brightened in the colour map, and a mask of them (eyes.png) for their glow; colour texture re-encoded as JPEG

author: klaimtrev
changes: Rest pose rebuilt from the skin's bind pose, re-oriented and rescaled, bones that deform nothing removed, its two animations left out (the game poses it), colour textures re-encoded as JPEG
used_for: The Tin Tyrant, the Toy Box's boss (Boss Battle)

author: restore50
changes: Decimated from 352k to 58k triangles, its texture transform baked into the UVs and its emission map dropped, re-oriented and rescaled; given a skeleton (21 bones) skinned by bone heat on a voxel-remeshed copy (tools/characters/boss_build.py); its colour texture painted to make it rabid (darker, matted fur, blood round its mouth, down its throat and on its paws, foam at its jaw, its eyes red) and re-encoded as JPEG, and a mask of its eyes (eyes.png) for their glow
used_for: Nibbles the Rabid, the Hamster Cage's boss (Boss Battle)

author: Pigcraft (s8819296)
changes: Its 22 pieces joined and welded, decimated from 1.9 million to 59k triangles, rescaled; given a skeleton (19 bones: its wings on the arms' bones, its talons on the feet's) skinned by bone heat on a voxel-remeshed copy (tools/characters/boss_build.py); the pupil of its left eye painted gold-green, and a mask of it (eyes.png) for its glow; colour textures re-encoded as JPEG
used_for: Old Hoot, the island's boss by night (Boss Battle)

author: Brian Trepanier (CMBC)
changes: Decimated from 315k to 59k triangles, re-oriented and rescaled; given a skeleton (21 bones, his jaw and hat included), its arms, legs, jaw and hat pinned rigid to their bones (a wooden toy's pegs) and the rest skinned by bone heat on a voxel-remeshed copy (tools/characters/boss_build.py); the full sculpt's detail baked into a tangent-space normal map (2048) and its ambient occlusion darkened into the colour map, upscaled to 2048; its painted irises masked (eyes.png) to glow; colour texture re-encoded as JPEG
used_for: Crackjaw, the Nutcracker General, the Toy Box's other boss (Boss Battle)

author: SDPM Esare (sdpm)
changes: Re-oriented, straightened and rescaled; given a skeleton (22 bones: a two-part tail, ears and a jaw) skinned by bone heat on a voxel-remeshed copy (tools/characters/boss_build.py), her mouth split along its lips so her jaw opens it (teeth and tongue pinned to the jaw and the head) and her eyes and whiskers pinned to her head; her painted eyes masked (eyes.png) to glow violet; colour texture re-encoded as JPEG
used_for: Noodle, the Burrow Hunter, the Hamster Cage's other boss (Boss Battle)
